args.value: Faros thesis (validated against Jun 2026 site): trace every AI token to the work it produced and the outcome it shipped. 'Your AI vendors tell you what you spent; Faros tells you what it produced.' Token Intelligence built on a Token Attribution Ledger + Engineering World Model. Sequence: understand spend -> optimize workflows -> maximize outcomes ('outcome maxxing > token maxxing'). Door=spend, room=outcomes/quality; explicitly NOT FinOps cost-cutting.
